claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG043159 reports PEID 43159, display name Kashmiri, country India and primary language Kashmiri (kas).
Glottolog identifies Kashmiri with glottocode kash1277 and ISO 639-3 code kas.

Sociolinguistic research describes changing language roles and linguistic identities within the Kashmiri speech community, while a phonological study of Srinagar Koshur documents one locality-specific variety; together these sources support linguistic diversity context without generalizing Srinagar findings to all Kashmiri speakers.
claims.interpretationNote: Kashmir is politically contested. These sources are used only for language and sociolinguistic context; no sovereignty, territorial or political-allegiance claim is inferred.
